agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py `_process_identifierlist`: removed an erroneous `self.wrap_after > 0 and` guard on the newline-insertion condition in the non-VALUES branch, which had disabled default one-identifier-per-line wrapping (since wrap_after defaults to 0). Restored condition to `if position > (self.wrap_after - self.offset):`, matching the sibling VALUES branch. Verified via direct sqlparse.format calls that default identifier list wrapping, wrap_after, comma_first, and comment-first scenarios all now behave correctly, matching pre-regression expectations from the bug report.
